title: Zesty Smoky Italian Eggplant Pasta
description: A sour and smoky Italian dish featuring pea eggplant, perfect for a date night, and friendly to Buddhist temple dietary preferences. This glassy-jelly textured pasta is sure to impress.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic.
Add the sliced pea eggplant to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and a splash of the pasta cooking water.
Add the lemon juice mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the eggplant and sauce.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil and serve immediately.
